# CodexAutoResume

> A portable Windows x64 utility that automatically resumes paused Codex desktop tasks when a supported right-pointing resume button is present, including interruptions described as at capacity.

Button recognition runs locally. Ordinary auto-resume clicks a strictly recognized resume triangle and checks the running square. Compact current-login quota bars normally refresh every 10 seconds. Version 1.1.20 prefers independently bound CDP/UIA composer controls over potentially stale covered-window captures. Existing ownership-verified CDP endpoints support minimized actions, input and navigation; unavailable minimized endpoints wait. Recent 30-minute log/export and opt-in bounded original-frame evidence remain. The affected device still needs acceptance. Off-by-default quota control pauses on any selected low quota and continues only after all selected quotas exceed their separate thresholds; a verified owned conversation may receive a custom continuation if its triangle is gone. Foreground input was exercised on this PC; CDP background input adaptation is implemented and owned minimized-window checks passed; real-app background submission remains pending. One-time recovery scheduling gates both resume paths by time and enabled quota conditions, expires on successful recovery and never replays after restart. Questions and permissions always require the user. It does not modify service capacity, quotas or server timers. CLI and browser automation are outside scope. Licensed under MIT.

Repository: https://github.com/ColinKiiim/codex-auto-resume

Downloads: https://github.com/ColinKiiim/codex-auto-resume/releases
